analysis.d: THE ARCHIVE’S OWN ERROR PROPAGATES INTACT. A deposit titled "ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ — Sappho 31 with Reconstructed FOURTH Stanza" is surfaced verbatim. Sappho 31 has FIVE stanzas; Cranes reconstructs the fifth.
analysis.reading:
NOT THE LAYER’S MISTAKE — THE ARCHIVE’S. Card 4 carries the deposit title "ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ — Sappho 31 with Reconstructed FOURTH Stanza", dated 2 February 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18459573. Sappho 31 has FIVE stanzas and the Cranes reconstruction supplies the FIFTH. The number is wrong in the archive’s own metadata, and the composition layer transmitted it faithfully.

This is the counterpart to the PhilPapers "Rebekah Crane" suffix drop and the AMiner paediatrics mismatch. Those were index-layer corruptions propagating downstream. This one originates AT THE ARCHIVE and propagates the same way. The registry must be able to say which direction an error travelled, and here it travelled outward.

Corroboration is already in the corpus: the 14 June «rebekah cranes sappho reconstruction» capture returned a GROKIPEDIA card stating that variants concern "the poem’s extent, particularly the fragmentary FIFTH STANZA consisting of three words". An unrelated source has the number right while the archive’s own title has it wrong.

Card 5 states the heteronym’s function plainly — "Rebekah Cranes is the LYRIC-TRANSLATION HETERONYM" — and licenses the work as public domain.
